plan.title: Progress by Gender
plan.subtitle: Comparing shuttle run times and sit-ups between baseline and endline for boys and girls.

panels.title: Total Children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Shuttle Run Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT endline.Gender, AVG(endline."Shuttle run sec") - AVG(baseline."Shuttle run sec") AS shuttle_diff FROM endline JOIN baseline ON endline."Child ID" = baseline."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Sit-Up Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT endline.Gender, AVG(endline.Sit_ups) - AVG(baseline.Sit_ups) AS situp_diff FROM endline JOIN baseline ON endline."Child ID" = baseline."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 10 Children by Shuttle Run Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT endline."Child name", endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec" AS improvement FROM endline JOIN baseline ON endline."Child ID" = baseline."Child ID" ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard compares the progress of children between their baseline and endline assessments. The key question is whether boys and girls are improving at similar rates. The 'Shuttle Run Improvement by Gender' panel shows the average difference in shuttle run times, while the 'Sit-Up Improvement by Gender' panel displays the average difference in sit-ups. A positive value indicates improvement. The 'Top 10 Children by Shuttle Run Improvement' table highlights the children who have shown the most significant gains in their shuttle run times. The total number of children is {{p1}}. The average shuttle run improvement for girls is {{p2.shuttle_diff}}, and for boys it is {{p2.shuttle_diff}}. The average sit-up improvement for girls is {{p3.situp_diff}}, and for boys it is {{p3.situp_diff}}.
